name: Slow Blues in A — 88 bpm
description: Slow blues in A at 88 bpm with a 12/8 feel: every beat is three triplet eighths, written as s, s and e with feel marks (2 and 4 ticks behind) so they land at 0, 1/3 and 2/3 of the beat. Quick-change 12-bar form A D A A | D D A A | E D A E. Rows 1-8 drums (ch 10), 9-B one-bar bass SUBROUTINES that C strings together (ch 13), F-I organ and piano (ch 15, one at a time), J strings (ch 16), K-L sax and harmonica answers (ch 11) calling the shared lick SUBROUTINES M-O, R guitar comping (ch 14), S-X sections, Y-Z jams. Row 0 plays the whole song.
prompt: another big collection of MPL to make a slow blues song, 88 beats per minute
